turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.

Mr. Hale. Meredith Kalinowski. Owen's mother.

I have twenty minutes. Then I have a client.

You entered a zero before you called me. I want to know why. I'd like to see the report, the date you ran it, and the date you entered the grade.

And before anything else: has Owen been spoken to in front of his class?

Good. Then answer my question first.

Has anyone said anything to Owen in front of the class? Yes or no.

Then the report. I want the tool's name and version. I want the date you ran it. I want the date and time you entered the zero.

Claire was given a zero at this school four years ago. It was wrong. It took an appeal to prove it, and the scholarship was gone by then.

So I'm not going to be vague about this. Show me what you have.
If you escalate this, I'll make sure the academic integrity committee sees everything, including his two late assignments from September.

Two late assignments.

Late is not the same as dishonest. You know that.

I'm not going to react to that. I'm going to write it down.

[She takes out a pen.]

Which two assignments? What dates were they due? What dates did Owen hand them in? Did he ask for an extension? Were marks deducted already?

If they were handled in September, they were handled. They don't get a second trial now.

And I'll say this once. I haven't escalated anything. I came in to ask questions. You brought up the committee.

So. The report. Show me.

Then here is my call.

I'm not agreeing to anything today. Not the zero, not a committee, nothing.

I want the report in writing. I want the date you ran it and the date you entered the zero. I want it by end of day.

Owen has drafts and version history. I'll look at them myself tonight. Dates and timestamps. I can check those.

Until then, nothing goes on his record. Nothing is said in that room.

Now answer me. Do you have the report with you, or don't you?
